avis.texte: Toner is ok. I didn't break out, so it gets points for that. I just don't think it's special enough for me to buy it again.

I didn't expect to like this toner as much as I do. The texture is slightly milky but still very light, and it absorbs into the skin really quickly. After using it for a while, my skin feels more hydrated and balanced, especially on days when it feels dry or tired.

The TIRTIR Milk Skin Toner is one of the most hydrating toners I've tried. The milky texture feels nourishing but still lightweight, and it absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky finish. My skin feels softer, brighter, and more balanced after using it.🩷
